long_biography.plain_text:
Chesterman spent the 1990s opening restaurants for Hard Rock Cafe and Planet Hollywood before returning to Britain and launching Bagelmania. A parking-ticket frustration at a video shop prompted ScreenSelect in 2003, beginning his move from physical retail into data-led consumer services. Mergers helped that business become LoveFilm, later acquired by Amazon.

He applied the same approach to property information when house hunting exposed how fragmented market data remained. Zoopla combined listings with pricing, school, crime and travel information, then expanded through acquisitions and a public listing. After Zoopla's 2018 sale, he founded Cazoo, which began selling used cars online the following year and later listed in New York.
